info.title: IncidentHub API
info.description: REST API for managing service ownership, dependencies, and incident lifecycle

tags.name: Service catalog
tags.description: Manage business services and their dependency graph

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Register users and obtain access tokens

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Administratively create login-enabled users and browse them

tags.name: Teams
tags.description: Create service-owning teams and browse them

tags.name: Incidents
tags.description: Register incidents, inspect history, and perform explicit lifecycle transitions

get.description: Returns users ordered by display name and identifier, optionally filtered by activity.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter by active or inactive users

400.description: Pagination or filter parameter is invalid

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

post.summary: Create a user as an administrator
post.description: Creates an active login-enabled user with the selected role. The normalized email must be unique.

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the required role

get.description: Returns teams ordered by name and identifier, optionally filtered by activity.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter by active or inactive teams

400.description: Pagination or filter parameter is invalid

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

post.description: Creates an active team. The normalized code must be unique.

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the required role

get.description: Returns services ordered by name and identifier with optional owner, tier, and activity filters.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Filter by active or inactive services

400.description: Pagination or filter parameter is invalid

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

post.description: Creates an active catalog service owned by an existing team. The normalized code must be unique.

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the required role

post.description: Declares that the service in the path depends on another existing service. Self-dependencies and duplicate pairs are rejected.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the service that depends on another service

400.description: Service identifier, dependency identifier, or type is invalid

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the required role

404.description: Dependent or required service was not found

409.description: Dependency already exists or points to the same service

get.description: Returns incidents ordered by creation time with optional lifecycle, urgency, impact, source, service, and team filters.

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Filter by business impact level, independent of priority

400.description: Pagination or filter parameter is invalid

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

post.description: Registers a manual incident in OPEN status for the authenticated user. The service owner is used as the responsible team when no team is supplied.

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

404.description: Authenticated user, affected service, or responsible team was not found

post.description: Moves an ASSIGNED incident to IN_PROGRESS. No other source status is allowed.

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the required role

post.description: Moves an IN_PROGRESS incident to RESOLVED. No other source status is allowed.

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the required role

post.description: Moves a RESOLVED incident back to IN_PROGRESS when the problem persists.

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the required role

post.description: Moves a RESOLVED incident to CLOSED. No other source status is allowed.

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the required role

post.description: Moves an OPEN, ASSIGNED, or IN_PROGRESS incident to CANCELLED. Resolved and closed incidents cannot be cancelled.

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the required role

409.description: Current incident status does not allow cancellation

post.description: Assigns or reassigns an existing user. Allowed only while the incident is OPEN or ASSIGNED.

200.description: Incident assigned and current details returned

400.description: Incident or assignee identifier is invalid

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the required role

404.description: Incident or assignee was not found

409.description: Current incident status does not allow assignment

post.description: Creates an active user with the REPORTER role
Returns a signed JWT access token

get.description: Returns the user identified by the authenticated principal

get.description: Returns service details together with its direct dependencies.

get.description: Traverses reverse dependencies and returns each affected service once at its minimum depth.

parameters.name: maxDepth
parameters.description: Maximum number of dependency levels to traverse, from 1 to 10

400.description: Service identifier or maximum depth is invalid

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

404.description: Root business service was not found

get.description: Returns the current incident details and assignments.

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

get.description: Returns lifecycle audit events in chronological order.

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

delete.description: Removes the direct dependency from the service in the path to the specified required service.

400.description: Service or dependency identifier is invalid

401.description: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid

403.description: The authenticated user does not have the required role

404.description: Service or dependency relationship was not found

email.description: Unique email; surrounding spaces are removed and case is normalized

code.description: Unique team code; stored trimmed and uppercase
Unique service code; stored trimmed and uppercase

ownerTeamId.description: Identifier of the team that owns the service

tier.description: Business criticality tier; TIER_1 is the most critical

dependencyServiceId.description: Identifier of the service required by the service in the path

type.description: Interaction type: synchronous call, asynchronous messaging, or data dependency

dependentServiceId.description: Service that depends on another service

dependencyServiceId.description: Service required by the dependent service

description.example: Authorization requests fail for one acquiring bank

affectedServiceId.description: Identifier of the service experiencing the failure

priority.description: Work ordering urgency, independent of business impact

severity.description: Business impact level; SEV1 is highest and is independent of priority

responsibleTeamId.description: Team responsible for resolution; defaults to the affected service owner when omitted

description.example: Authorization requests fail for one acquiring bank

severity.description: Business impact level, independent of priority

availableActions.description: Lifecycle actions available to the current user in the current status

assigneeId.description: Active user who will handle the incident

active.description: Whether the current user is active

dependencies.description: Services directly required by this service

active.description: Whether the required service is active
Whether the affected service is active

depth.description: Minimum number of dependency edges from the failed service

dependencyType.description: Type of the edge used on the selected minimum-depth path

items.description: Deduplicated affected services ordered by minimum depth

businessServiceId.description: Identifier of the failed root service

maxDepth.description: Maximum dependency depth traversed by the query

severity.description: Business impact level, independent of priority

eventType.description: Lifecycle action that produced the event

fromStatus.description: Status before the action; null for CREATED

actorId.description: User who performed the action; null for legacy events

actorDisplayName.description: Display name of the action author; null for legacy events
